bugs.bug_name: Search filters reset after pagination
bugs.bug_description: On Search, my selected filters are cleared as soon as I move to page 2. Expected the filters to persist while paging.

bugs.bug_name: CSV Export does not send the expected notification
bugs.bug_description: When something changes in CSV Export, no email or in-app notification arrives. Expected the assigned person to be notified.

bugs.bug_name: Project List shows stale data until a hard refresh
bugs.bug_description: Project List keeps showing the old data after I make a change. I have to press Ctrl+F5 before the new values appear. Expected it to update on its own.

bugs.bug_name: Bug Detail accepts an empty required field
bugs.bug_description: Bug Detail lets me submit with the required field empty, then shows a server error. Expected inline validation before submitting.

bugs.bug_name: Mobile View crashes after clicking Save
bugs.bug_description: When I open Mobile View and click Save, the page goes blank and the console throws "Cannot read properties of undefined". Expected my changes to save. It happens every time in Chrome.

bugs.bug_name: CSV Export takes more than 30 seconds to load
bugs.bug_description: CSV Export sits on a spinner for over 30 seconds before anything renders. Other pages load in under two seconds. This started this week and is blocking my work.

bugs.bug_name: Mobile View layout breaks on smaller screens
bugs.bug_description: The Mobile View layout overlaps and text is cut off on a 1366px laptop screen. Expected it to reflow the same way the other pages do.

bugs.bug_name: File Upload returns incorrect results
bugs.bug_description: File Upload returns results that do not match what I entered. I searched for an exact value and got unrelated rows. Expected only the matching records.

bugs.bug_name: Notifications loses my unsaved changes
bugs.bug_description: I filled in the Notifications form, switched tabs for a moment, and came back to an empty form. Expected my input to still be there.

bugs.bug_name: Project List creates a duplicate on double click
bugs.bug_description: If I click the submit button twice on Project List, two identical records are created. Expected the second click to be ignored.

bugs.bug_name: Dashboard displays the wrong date
bugs.bug_description: Dashboard shows dates one day earlier than what I entered. Expected the date I picked. This only happens in the evening.
